_comment: Reconstructed Linear GraphQL Issue payload for spec 016/3 regression coverage. Models a real issue with multiple inline-pasted screenshots (description + comment) plus formal Attachment records (link previews) that must NOT be picked up as inline images. Sanitized: synthetic team/user/issue IDs, no leaky free-form text. Test fixture only — never imported by production code.
_purpose: Pinned by tests/unit/pm/linear/extraction-coverage.test.ts. If Linear changes the Issue payload shape in a way that loses inline images, that test fails loudly.

issue.title: Bug from screenshot fixture
issue.description:
## Repro

The Tasks Hub mobile layout breaks when the title wraps to a third line.

![](https://uploads.linear.app/abc-123-def-456-extension-less-uuid)

## Expected

Layout should match the design in this annotated screenshot:

![Annotated mockup](https://uploads.linear.app/xyz-789-with-alt-text/Mockup.png)

Reference image hosted externally:

![External logo](https://example.com/logo.svg)

A non-image link (should NOT be picked up as media):

[See related ticket](https://linear.app/example/issue/MNG-100)

attachments._comment: Linear's Issue.attachments connection holds formal Attachment records — link previews from Slack/GitHub/Sentry/etc. — NOT inline-pasted screenshots. The extraction-coverage test asserts these are NOT mistaken for inline images.
